action.intro: Enter the shares you want to redeem and the minimum amount you want back. Those amounts become requirements of the transaction.
action.boundary: The withdrawal and swaps complete together
action.estimate_note: The quote can change before execution. The minimum you sign is what the contract must enforce.
review.heading: Check what you are approving
review.intro: The signed minimum below applies to the total delivered to your wallet, after the vault redemption and any swaps.
review.minimum_changed: This minimum is lower than the one you reviewed earlier. Check the new amount before you sign.
review.expiry_note: The transaction must complete before both the time and ledger limits.
review.expired: This transaction has expired. Get a new quote and review the amounts again.
review.stale: This review is too old to sign. Refresh it so the quote, balance and fee can be checked again.
review.missing: This review couldn't be found. Return to the workspace to prepare a new transaction.
review.share_note: This link shows the transaction's amounts and conditions to anyone who opens it. Signing still requires the account named in the review.
review.failure_fee: If the transaction fails, its withdrawal and swap changes are reversed. Stellar can still charge the network fee.
route.heading: Withdrawal and swap route
route.unsupported: We couldn't prepare this transaction for the supported vault route. Check the amounts and request another quote.
route.changed: The contract or route details don't match this deployment. Don't sign this review. Check the contract details before trying again.
fee.changed: The required fee is above this deployment's limit. This transaction can't be signed as prepared.
pending.heading: Stellar has not confirmed this yet
pending.body: The transaction was submitted. Its result will appear here once Stellar confirms it.
pending.unknown: We don't have a confirmed result for this hash. That doesn't tell us whether the transaction failed or completed. Check it before sending another withdrawal.
pending.leave: The transaction hash is saved in this browser. You can return through Transactions to check it later.
pending.storage_unavailable: This browser couldn't save the transaction hash. Keep the receipt link somewhere you can find it later.
success.heading: Stellar confirmed the withdrawal. The amounts below come from the contract's receipt.
success.receipt_unavailable: Stellar confirmed the transaction, but we couldn't verify the contract's receipt. Don't treat an unverified amount as a confirmed return.
failure.heading: The transaction failed
failure.body: The transaction's asset changes were reversed. The network fee can still be charged; check the confirmed details below.
failure.minimum: The withdrawal or swaps didn't meet the amounts you required. Get another quote before deciding whether to change your minimum.
failure.shares: There aren't enough vault shares in this account for that withdrawal. Refresh the balance and enter a smaller amount.
failure.authority: The signed request doesn't match the transaction you reviewed. Prepare a new review before signing again.
failure.generic: Stellar confirmed that this transaction failed. Its recorded result is below; refresh the quote before trying another withdrawal.
activity.heading: Your transactions
activity.scope: These are the transactions this browser has tracked with Mierkhat. This list isn't your wallet's complete history.
activity.empty: No tracked transactions yet. There's no paperwork until you actually do something.
receipt.heading: Transaction receipt
receipt.unresolved: The available network services haven't confirmed this hash. Keep checking it before creating another withdrawal.
details.copy_failed: Copying didn't work. The value is still selectable, so you can copy it manually.
input.invalid: Use digits and a decimal point for the amount. Commas, signs and scientific notation aren't accepted.
input.precision: Use no more than {decimals} digits after the decimal point for this token.
input.too_large: This amount is larger than the contract can handle. Check the digits and enter a smaller amount.
service.unavailable: We couldn't read the network just now. Your entered amounts are still here. Try the request again before signing.
service.offline: The browser appears to be offline. Reconnect before requesting a quote or checking a transaction.
service.busy: The request limit has been reached. Wait a little before trying again.
help.guarantee: For a supported exit, Mierkhat checks the exact shares spent and the minimum settlement tokens received. The withdrawal and swaps must pass those checks to complete.
help.limits: The minimum applies to the number of tokens received in this transaction. It doesn't promise what those tokens will be worth later, or stop their issuer from freezing them.
app.tagline: Redeem vault shares with a minimum return.
app.deliver: Send the result to your account
app.shares_note: The contract checks the exact number of shares redeemed.
app.outcome_note: The swaps don't spend underlying tokens you already held before this withdrawal.
app.route_note: The withdrawn assets are swapped directly through Soroswap, without an intermediate token.
app.freshness_empty: Request a quote to see the current expected return.
app.activity_note: Each submitted transaction has a hash you can look up later.
app.supported_body: Redeem vault shares and swap their underlying assets into one settlement token.
app.not_connected: Connect a wallet to read its vault share balance.
app.brand_footer: Vault withdrawals, with the minimum you chose.
app.help_intro: A vault holds a pool of tokens. You receive shares when you deposit, and redeem those shares to withdraw your portion. Mierkhat swaps the withdrawn assets into one settlement token and checks the amount that reaches your wallet.
app.help_fee_body: A failed transaction reverses its asset changes, but Stellar can still charge a fee and advance the account sequence. If the result is unknown, check the hash first. Signing a second withdrawal could create a separate transaction.
app.help_wallet: Does Mierkhat need my wallet keys?
app.help_wallet_body: Your wallet keeps its private keys. Mierkhat sends it a transaction to review and sign; the app never asks you to enter a recovery phrase.
app.details_empty: There isn't an enabled deployment to inspect. Contract addresses will appear when one is available.
app.copy_identity: Copy the full address or hash
app.required_minima: Minimums for each withdrawal and swap
app.pending_hold: Check your tracked transaction before preparing another withdrawal.
app.storage_continue: I saved the link. Submit this transaction.
app.storage_before_send: This browser couldn't save a recovery record. Keep the receipt link before submitting, so you can still check the result if you close the page.
app.invalid_hash: This receipt link doesn't contain a valid Stellar transaction hash.
app.review_verifying: Reading and verifying the shared review
app.review_other_owner: This review names a different account. Connect that account to sign it, or prepare your own withdrawal in the workspace.
app.minimum_confirm: I understand that I am accepting the lower minimum.
app.not_found: This address doesn't lead to a Mierkhat page. Return to the workspace to continue.
app.signing_cancelled: You left the review. Any later response from that wallet request will be ignored.
app.share_decimals: The vault records shares to {decimals} decimal places.
app.mainnet_unavailable: This version uses testnet. Mainnet transactions are not enabled.
app.embed_unavailable: This withdrawal couldn't be checked. Request a new review before signing.
app.link_saved: Save the receipt link before you submit.
app.minimum_note: This is the least you agree to receive, not the amount the quote happens to show.
home.intro: Mierkhat redeems vault shares, swaps the withdrawn assets into one token, and sends it to your wallet. You set the least you'll accept. If they can't meet that minimum, the withdrawal and swaps are reversed.
home.route_title: From vault shares to one token.
home.route_note: A vault can return more than one asset when you withdraw. Mierkhat swaps those assets into the settlement token shown in your review, then checks the total delivered to your account.
home.live: What is in the vault right now
home.live_note: These figures are read from Stellar and refreshed as new ledgers arrive.
home.flow_wallet: Send the settlement tokens to you
home.promise_intro: A quote tells you what the route is expected to return. Your signature sets the amounts the contract must enforce. There are four parts to that.
home.condition_spend: Only the shares you entered can be spent
home.condition_spend_body: A vault holds a pool of tokens. Depositing gives you shares that track your portion of it. You choose how many shares to redeem, and the contract checks that exact number. It cannot take extra shares to make the swaps work.
home.condition_receive: Your account must receive the minimum
home.condition_receive_body: The quote is an estimate. The minimum is a requirement. Mierkhat counts the settlement tokens actually delivered to your account. If that amount is too low, the withdrawal and swaps are reversed.
home.condition_balance: The swaps use assets from this withdrawal
home.condition_balance_body: Already holding one of the vault's tokens? That balance isn't there to cover a bad swap. Only assets released by this withdrawal fund the conversions.
home.condition_expiry_body: Each exit has a time deadline and a ledger deadline. A ledger is a confirmed batch of Stellar transactions. The exit must complete before both limits, so an expired signature cannot be used for a later trade.
home.start_title: Try the full withdrawal on testnet.
home.start_body: Connect Freighter to start. If your account needs XLM or tokens, the workspace has controls for that. Deposit into the vault, then redeem your shares and follow the transaction through to its receipt.
home.testnet_note: This runs on Stellar's testnet. The tokens aren't worth money, but wallet approvals and transactions still go through the network. The contracts have not had an independent security audit.
footer.note: Vault withdrawals, with the minimum you chose.
workspace.heading: Deposit or withdraw.
workspace.intro: Holding shares already? You can redeem them here. Otherwise, deposit tokens first.
workspace.ready: Connect to see your vault shares
workspace.connect_body: Your share balance tells us how much you can withdraw. Connect Freighter on Stellar testnet to read it, deposit tokens or redeem the shares you already hold. You'll review the amounts before approving a transaction.
workspace.action_note: Shares represent your position in the vault. Redeeming them returns the underlying tokens, which Mierkhat swaps into the settlement token shown in your review.
setup.heading: Prepare this testnet account
setup.body: For a new account, start with XLM, allow the vault's tokens, then request a token grant. You only need the steps your account is missing.
setup.faucet_note: The faucet sends 1000 of each vault token and the settlement token to your account, once every 24 hours. You'll need to approve the trustlines first. These tokens have no monetary value.
setup.trust_required: Allow the listed tokens in your wallet before requesting a faucet grant.
setup.trust_body: A trustline lets a Stellar account hold a token from a particular issuer. You're adding the listed tokens to this account. This doesn't give anyone permission to spend them, though the account needs XLM for Stellar's required reserves.
funding.unavailable: Friendbot couldn't fund this account. Wait a little, then request the testnet XLM again.
faucet.unavailable: This server doesn't have a testnet issuer configured. You can still use tokens already in your account.
faucet.busy: The faucet is finishing another grant. Check again once that transaction has been confirmed.
faucet.limit: The faucet has reached its daily allowance. Tokens already in your account can still be deposited.
deposit.heading: Deposit tokens for vault shares
deposit.intro: Enter how much of each vault token you'd like to deposit. The vault accepts them in its current proportions and gives you shares in return. Any tokens it doesn't accept stay in your wallet.
deposit.minimum: At least this much {token} must be accepted
deposit.note: The vault uses its current asset proportions. It may leave some of your entered tokens in your wallet. Check both the accepted amounts and the minimums below.
deposit.rejected: The vault couldn't accept this deposit with these limits. Check both token balances and whether the amounts match the vault's proportions.
deposit.sign: Sign the deposit in your wallet
deposit.ratio: The vault accepts assets in its current proportions. An extra amount of one token may be left in your wallet.
deposit.shares_note: The share amount is an estimate from the vault. This deposit sets minimum token amounts to accept, but does not enforce a minimum number of shares issued.
exit.heading: Redeem your shares and swap the assets
exit.intro: Enter the shares to redeem, then request a quote. You'll see what each swap is expected to return and set the least the whole transaction must deliver to your wallet.
exit.minimum_note: The quote and your tolerance set the starting minimum. Edit it to the amount you're willing to accept, then check every withdrawal and swap limit in the review.
exit.quote_expired: This quote is too old to use. Request another before reviewing the withdrawal.
exit.empty: Request a quote to see the withdrawal amounts and swap returns.
exit.balance: This is more than the account currently holds. Refresh the balance or enter a smaller amount.
exit.no_shares: This account has no vault shares to redeem. Deposit tokens first, then return here to withdraw them.
exit.high_minimum: The current quote is below this minimum. Request another quote or decide whether you're willing to accept less.
activity.lookup_note: A transaction hash is its identifier on Stellar. Paste one from testnet to check the result, even if you didn't submit it from this browser.
receipt.submission_unknown: The server hasn't acknowledged this submission. It may already have reached Stellar, so use this hash to check the result or retry the same signed transaction.
receipt.original: Check this hash on Stellar Expert
receipt.no_guard: Stellar confirmed this transaction. Withdrawal amounts are shown only when Mierkhat can verify the guard contract's receipt; confirmation alone doesn't prove a particular return.
receipt.saved: This transaction hash is saved in your browser.
receipt.downloaded: The receipt file has been saved
receipt.resume_note: Checking this hash doesn't require a wallet connection. If Mierkhat accepted the submission, it can retry the original signed transaction while that transaction is still valid.
review.confirm: I have checked the amounts, minimums and network fee.
review.share: Copy a link to this review
contracts.heading: The contracts behind this transaction
contracts.body: Mierkhat uses a fixed vault and swap route. The browser checks the contract addresses and code hashes before signing, and the guard checks them during execution. These are the contracts used by this testnet deployment.
contracts.profile: Hash of the approved route configuration
contracts.review_note: The source code and integration have been checked for this testnet deployment. That work is not an independent security audit; one has not been completed.
help.title: How a Mierkhat withdrawal works
help.fees: Can a failed transaction still cost XLM?
help.pending: Should I try again if the result is unknown?
help.pending_body: Check the transaction hash first. The network may have accepted the transaction even if the browser missed its response. Mierkhat looks it up before retrying the same signed bytes. A newly signed withdrawal could be a separate transaction.
help.testnet_body: The account funding, trustlines, token grants, deposits and withdrawals are transactions on Stellar testnet. Your wallet approves them and the network records their results. The tokens have no monetary value, so this isn't a place to deposit funds you bought.
help.preflight: Why does Freighter show a simulation?
help.preflight_body: Soroban checks a contract call before submission to work out its permissions, resources and fee. That check can produce a quote, but it doesn't complete a withdrawal. Mierkhat waits for the signed transaction's recorded network result before showing a confirmed receipt.
error.wallet_install: Install Freighter if needed, unlock it and select Stellar testnet before reconnecting.
app.no_deployment: No testnet vault is enabled right now. There isn't a supported transaction to sign.
input.hash_required: Use the full transaction hash: 64 hexadecimal characters, without spaces.
restore.heading: Review contract restoration
restore.body: Stellar can archive contract data that hasn't been kept active. This transaction restores the route's contract instances and code if needed. It has a separate fee and doesn't redeem shares or transfer your vault tokens.
restore.unavailable: The restoration request couldn't be prepared. No restoration transaction has been submitted from this request.
restore.scope: This request can restore only the contract instances and code fixed by this deployment. Once it's confirmed, prepare a new deposit or withdrawal review.
receipt.keep_open: Leave this page open until the server accepts the retry. The signed transaction is held here in memory; the saved hash alone can't submit it.
wallet.choose_intro: Pick the wallet that holds your vault shares. It will ask you to approve the connection before Mierkhat can read your account.
wallet.connecting_note: Open the Freighter request to continue. If the wallet is locked, unlock it in the extension first.
wallet.timeout: Freighter hasn't responded. Open the extension and finish or close its connection request, then try again.
wallet.request_open: There's already a Freighter request waiting. Finish or close that request before opening another.
wallet.supported: This testnet deployment currently supports Freighter.
wallet.detection_failed: Freighter didn't respond to the extension check. Open it, then check again.
exit.slippage_note: Choose how much lower each quoted withdrawal or swap may go. This also sets a starting minimum for the total you receive; you can edit that amount below.
help.settlement: Which token do I receive after the swaps?
help.settlement_body: The settlement token is what this route sends back after the swaps. A vault can hold several assets, but Mierkhat converts what you withdraw into that one token. Check its symbol and contract address in the review before signing.
help.atomic: Why put the withdrawal and swaps together?
help.atomic_body: Separate transactions can complete independently. A withdrawal could succeed before a later swap fails. Mierkhat runs its supported withdrawal and swaps in one transaction, then checks the final amount received. A failed check reverses that transaction's asset changes, though Stellar can still charge a fee.
positions.heading: Choose a vault position
positions.deposit_heading: Choose a vault to deposit into
positions.note: Each vault has one share balance. Deposits into the same vault add to that balance.
positions.choose: Select a vault you hold shares in
positions.output_note: Only tokens with a verified route for this vault are listed. Changing the token clears the quote and review.
positions.empty: This wallet has no shares in the supported vaults. Choose Deposit tokens to open a position.
receipt.awaiting_metadata: Stellar has confirmed the transaction. We are waiting for its receipt data to verify the amounts received.
redemption.only_output: {token} is the only token this withdrawal sends to your wallet.
redemption.internal_flow: The vault releases {assets} inside the transaction. Those proceeds are converted to {token} before payment.
redemption.direct: This vault already holds {token}, so no swap is needed.
redemption.internal_note: These amounts describe the vault’s internal redemption and swaps. The final payment is {token}.
readiness.heading: What can you withdraw?
readiness.intro: Check a supported position and see what it can return in your chosen token. No signature needed.
readiness.coverage: This checks the vaults listed here. Other positions are outside our current coverage.
readiness.privacy: The service receives the address you enter. Checking it gives Mierkhat no permission to move funds.
readiness.full: The full position passed the check.
readiness.partial: A smaller withdrawal passed the check.
readiness.blocked: None of the tested amounts passed.
readiness.setup: There is an account setup step to finish.
readiness.empty: This account has no shares in this vault.
readiness.unknown: We could not establish a withdrawal result.
readiness.fee: Maximum network fee for the tested transaction
readiness.note: This is a recent check, not reserved liquidity. Conditions can change before you sign. A partial result is the largest amount tested, not a proven maximum.
readiness.trust: Add the required token trustlines in the workspace.
readiness.unavailable: A complete withdrawal could not be verified. Your balance is not being treated as zero.
readiness.no_candidate: The complete transaction rejected the tested amounts. This alone does not identify a liquidity shortage.
plan.mode: Choose how to size your withdrawal
plan.intro: Choose your receiving amount. We will test a share quantity that can cover it, including the conversion.
plan.note: The token minimum is enforced if the transaction succeeds. Rounding may leave you with a little more.
plan.unavailable: We could not find a supported withdrawal that meets that amount. Try a smaller amount or check your position.
plan.setup: Finish account funding and token trustlines before planning a withdrawal.
migration.heading: Move part of your position
migration.intro: Choose a source position and a destination vault. The withdrawal, conversions and deposit happen together.
migration.remainder: Source shares left after this move
migration.refund_note: Any conversion surplus or unused deposit assets return to your wallet. Existing balances are preserved.
migration.guarantee: Receive at least the reviewed destination shares or the whole action reverts. A failed transaction can still cost network fees.
migration.scope: These routes use the listed testnet vaults. Strategy and queued positions need their own reviewed integration.
migration.connect: Connect your wallet to select a position.
migration.confirm: I checked both vaults, the source shares and the minimum destination shares.
migration.empty: No supported migration route is enabled.
migration.notices: You will receive vault shares. The conversion token is an internal step, not a separate wallet payment.
migration.receipt: The destination vault shares and any refunds are confirmed on Stellar.
watch.created: Watch saved. Updates appear in Alerts.
watch.heading: Your withdrawal alerts
watch.intro: Keep an eye on a withdrawal or vault move. We check the conditions; you decide whether to sign.
watch.note: Watches last seven days and are checked about once a minute. An alert describes a recent check, not a guaranteed future result.
watch.storage: This browser could not save access to the watch. Enable local storage before trying again.
watch.empty: You have no saved watches in this browser. Create one from a withdrawal check or migration quote.
watch.met: Your conditions passed a fresh check.
watch.unmet: Your conditions have not been met.
watch.unknown: We could not check these conditions.
watch.not_found: This watch expired, was removed, or is unavailable to this browser.
watch.busy: The watch is being checked. Try again shortly.
watch.permission_note: Alerts work here without browser permission. No email or outside messages are sent.
watch.permission_denied: Browser notifications are unavailable. Your alerts are still shown here.
watch.load_failed: We could not load the latest watch state. Try refreshing.
